t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Please find the gnome that gives you the most mushrooms and keep going with that gnome until it is empty

vb_textbox.text: After you work out which basket gives more points, keep selecting the gnomes that are associated to this basket. After the supply ends, you need to switch to the other basket until that basket also runs down. the red basket is associated to the red, purple and brown gnomes.
